notes.title: OUT NOW!!
notes.content:
Attack of the Mechadonk - the ultimate donkey is now available to purchase. Head on over to the store page and check it out.

Thanks for all the support on this exciting journey.

Hope you enjoy this fun title.

notes.title: One Week
notes.content:
After a lot of hard work, we are proud to release Attack of the Mechadonk - the ultimate donkey in one week on Monday the 30th of November. 

Please take a look at the trailer and if you like what you see, add it to your wishlist. Thanks!!

Looking forward to seeing you on launch day.
